description: This file defines the ResultSet class for 'RecipeOfTheDay' in the Coocook schema, including a method 'today' that retrieves recipes of the day, optionally selecting random recipes.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::RecipeOfTheDay
classes.description: A ResultSet class for handling 'RecipeOfTheDay' entries, providing methods to retrieve recipes of the day.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Retrieves all RecipeOfTheDay objects for today, optionally selecting a specified number of recipes at random, with linked recipes prefetched.
